sum: Ucommune International Ltd provides agile office space services in China. It operates through two segments: Workspace Membership and Other Services. The company operates self-operated and asset-light models. It also provides individual services, such as catering, fitness, healthcare, training, and entertainment; general corporate services, including corporate secretary, human resources, legal, finance, IT support, and tax services; incubation and corporate venturing services; design and build services; advertising and branding services; and related services. It serves individuals and enterprises under the U brand. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
ceo: Mr. Zirui  Wang (CEO & Chief Risk Officer)
